'''Southview Village''' was a small settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. Locations within the town included the [[Settlement Offices]], [[Otis' Livery]], and the [[K-O Bar]]. Shortly after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assault on [[Edan Base]], surviving [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] arrived at the village. Meeting up with the Alliance agent [[Dantaree]], they investigated the disappearance of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] in the region.
